mapper.select: SELECT dining_tables.id AS id, dining_tables.code AS code, dining_tables.capacity AS capacity, table_qr_codes.token AS activeQrToken, sales_sessions.status AS sessionStatus, sales_sessions.public_id AS sessionPublicId FROM dining_tables LEFT JOIN table_qr_codes ON table_qr_codes.table_id = dining_tables.id AND table_qr_codes.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = ( SELECT active_sessions.id FROM sales_sessions active_sessions WHERE active_sessions.table_id = dining_tables.id AND active_sessions.status IN ('OPEN', 'PAYMENT_PENDING') ORDER BY active_sessions.created_at ASC, active_sessions.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE dining_tables.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY dining_tables.code ASC

SELECT dining_tables.id AS tableId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, table_qr_codes.token AS token FROM dining_tables INNER JOIN table_qr_codes ON table_qr_codes.table_id = dining_tables.id AND table_qr_codes.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE dining_tables.store_id = #{storeId} AND dining_tables.id = #{tableId}

SELECT dining_tables.id AS tableId, dining_tables.store_id AS storeId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode FROM table_qr_codes INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id = table_qr_codes.table_id WHERE table_qr_codes.token = #{qrToken} AND table_qr_codes.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT sales_sessions.public_id AS sessionPublicId, sales_sessions.opened_by_customer_name AS customerName, sales_sessions.status AS sessionStatus FROM sales_sessions WHERE sales_sessions.table_id = #{tableId} AND sales_sessions.session_type = 'DINE_IN' AND sales_sessions.status IN ('OPEN', 'PAYMENT_PENDING') ORDER BY sales_sessions.created_at ASC, sales_sessions.id ASC
